name: EPA ECHO sewer overflow and bypass event reports (eRule Phase 2, SOBE), Puerto Rico permits
operator: US EPA (filed by PRASA through NeT-SewerOverflow)
waters_covered: all PRASA sewer systems island-wide; receiving water per event (Spanish or English free text)
access_detail: Daily ZIP from ECHO; join sewer_overflow_bypass_report_events.csv to _types.csv and _receiving_waters.csv on sewer_overflow_bypass_event_key. Filter permit_identifier LIKE 'PR%'. Extracted 2026-11-04 from the copy in the shared scratchpad (downloaded 2026-11-03). Sample: research/pr/raw/sobe-sample.json.
cannot_fill: published_at (no per-row publication time; daily file)
cadence: ECHO file rebuilt daily; permittee files within days (median 2 days start to receipt, Puerto Rico 2025-04 to 2026-11)
history: Starts 2025-04-03 (receipts from 2025-08-18): 314 events in 2025, 607 in 2026 to 2026-10-31. Types: SSO 847, BYP 77; no CSO-typed rows although Puerto Nuevo has 12 CSO outfalls.
license: US federal government data; no restriction stated by ECHO.
status_reason: The only island-wide dated overflow record: 924 events from 45 PRASA permits, every row with a point, start, end and volume; median two days from start to receipt.
notes: Owner type 'State Government' (PRASA) on 844 rows. Receiving-water names are inconsistent ('RIO BAIROA' and 'BAIROA RIVER'; 'unnamed creek' 29; 'CREEK (UNKNOWN THE NAME)' 21): match on coordinates, not names.

name: PRASA combined sewer overflow outfalls (ArcGIS feature service CSO_Data)
waters_covered: San Juan Bay, Rio Puerto Nuevo, Canal Martin Pena (Puerto Nuevo system)
access_detail: query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&f=json returns 12 features (Web Mercator). Feeds the Experience Builder app 'Sistema de Alcantarillado Combinado' (item f157b11700644d1fb0286809f384f457, public, created 2026-03) embedded at acueductos.pr.gov/en-us/combinado/mapa-de-ubicacion-csos. Other service folders on the server need a token. Sample: research/pr/raw/cso-data-sample.json.
license: No terms on the layer; site footer links PRASA 'Terms of use'.
legal_basis: 2016 consent decree as modified 2023 (Puerto Nuevo CSO web communication)
status_reason: Public point layer of the 12 Puerto Nuevo CSO outfalls with name, number, receiving water, its designated uses and controls; better names than the EPA inventory. No overflow events.

name: PRASA 'Combined Sanitary Overflows (CSOs)' web pages (home, location map, precautions, efforts, 'Notify a CSO')
access_detail: Webflow site; sub-pages /combinado/mapa-de-ubicacion-csos, /precauciones-a-seguir, /esfuerzos, /notificar-csos. No feed. reCAPTCHA on forms.
legal_basis: US v. PRASA, No. 3:15-cv-02283 (D.P.R.), 2016 consent decree, 2023 modification
status_reason: The 2023 consent-decree modification adds a duty to tell the public on PRASA's web of CSO discharges and their estimated volume, but the pages fetched show only locations, precautions and a form for the public to report an overflow; no event list found.
notes: Watch for the CSO discharge and volume posting the modification requires.

name: EPA Region 2 NPDES permit PR0021555, PRASA Puerto Nuevo RWWTP (2021), CSO permit conditions
status_reason: Source of the CSO public-notification clause (Nine Minimum Controls #8).
notes: Clause: 'The permittee shall implement a public notification process to inform citizens of when and where CSOs occur. The process must include (a) a mechanism to alert persons of the occurrence of CSOs and (b) a system to determine the nature and duration of conditions that are potentially harmful for users of receiving waters due to CSOs.' No deadline. Dry weather CSOs: 'must be reported to the permitting authority as soon as the permittee becomes aware'.

name: US v. PRASA consent decree (2016) and 2023 modification; EPA Region 2 public notice
status_reason: States the new web-communication duty for Puerto Nuevo CSOs.
notes: Quote (Spanish notice): 'Requerimientos adicionales relacionados con la comunicación al público, a través de la web de la AAA, con información concerniente a las descargas de desbordes de aguas pluviales mezcladas con aguas sanitarias procedentes de los puntos de descarga de alcantarillado combinado permitidos y el volumen estimado de dichos desbordamientos que llegan a un cuerpo de agua.' Whether the modification was entered, and its deadline, not confirmed.

name: DRNA Programa de Monitoría de Playas y Notificación Pública: weekly 'Notificación Monitoria de Playas' (WordPress category 1424)
operator: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales (DRNA)
waters_covered: 36 to 38 coastal beaches (stations RW-1 to RW-39)
access_detail: GET https://www.drna.pr.gov/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?categories=1424&per_page=100&_fields=id,date,modified,title,link,content (no auth; X-WP-Total 278). content.rendered holds the sampling dates and an HTML table Estación | Nombre de la Playa | Municipio of beaches that exceed the BAV; a PDF copy and the station table PDF (https://www.drna.pr.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/Tabla-playas.pdf) are linked. Sample: research/pr/raw/drna-beach-posts.json.

sample_record.title: Notificación Monitoria de Playas
sample_record.text: A base de los resultados de los muestreos del 26 de octubre de 2026 ... no son aptas para bañistas por exceder el 'Beach Action Value' (BAV) para el parámetro de Enterococos (70 colonias/100 mL): RW-6 Balneario de Patillas, Patillas; RW-30 Playa Guayanés, Yabucoa

fields: content.rendered (sampling date text; table of station, beach, municipality)
cannot_fill: ended_at (only implied by the next week's list)
coordinates (station table has none; BEACON or WQX may)
cadence: weekly (about 3 to 5 a month), posted 3 to 4 days after sampling
status_reason: Weekly island-wide beach advisories with station ids, as JSON through the WordPress REST API; 278 notices since 2019-10.
notes: Lists only the beaches that fail; all others are implied as passing, which the site must not show as clean. Station ids are not always consistent (2026-10-16 lists Playa Cabullón as RW-30; the station table has Cabullón as RW-34 and Guayanés as RW-30): key on name and municipality as well.

name: EPA BEACON 2.0, Puerto Rico beaches
status_reason: Season-late; station coordinates likely the useful part.

name: Senado de Puerto Rico, R. del S. 310 (2025-09-22): investigation of sewage discharges to the sea and other waters
status_reason: Pending legislative investigation; its motives propose standardized weekly public reports of incidents (date, cause, duration, estimated volume).
notes: Objective (3): 'estandarizar reportes públicos semanales de calidad de agua (enterococos, E. coli) y de incidentes (fecha, causa, duración, volumen estimado)'. A resolution ordering an investigation, not law. R. del S. 502 (2026) on Puerto Nuevo illegal discharges seen in search only.

name: Programa del Estuario de la Bahía de San Juan: bacteriological monitoring (Condado lagoon, San Juan beaches)
status_reason: Annual or periodic PDF reports; useful context for San Juan Bay CSO waters.

name: Surfrider Foundation Blue Water Task Force, Puerto Rico chapters (Rincón, Isabela)
status_reason: Volunteer bacteria results; named in R. del S. 310 for Isabela.

name: Permit spill and bypass reporting to DNER Point Sources Permits Division (bypass@jca.pr.gov)
status_reason: A regulator-only channel; no public output found.
notes: Permit PR0021555 directs written spill notice to DNER within 24 hours (solid-waste spill clause); there is no public register of these.
